title: Agent Frontmatter Schema
description: Validates YAML frontmatter in .agent.md files. All agents MUST conform to this schema.

name.description: Agent identifier (lowercase, kebab-case). Must match filename without .agent.md suffix.

description.description: One-line specialist description. Shows in agent picker.

version.description: Agent version (major.minor). Bump major on breaking changes, minor on enhancements.

keywords.description: Discovery keywords for routing. Used by @planner and @coordinator for agent-task matching.

coordinate.description: Tasks requiring coordination with other agents.

mcp_servers.description: MCP servers this agent requires (e.g., filesystem, git, github).
